scope: General source-witness library v1 for web-session/source-audit reuse
publication_decision: Source-intake / project-source upload candidate only. This is not a cumulative TeX/PDF reader update, not a paper patch, not certification, and not a critical edition.
purpose: Provide stable source witnesses and ledgers separately from per-turn working drops.
Avoid forcing web sessions to sort through multi-GB temporary work folders.
Keep each upload part below approximately 500 MB for project-source upload workflows.
contents_summary: Part 01: collected-volume and tail/source cutout PDFs, including collected Abhandlungen source and Kapferer/HADW tail witnesses.
Part 02: Internet Archive Mathematische Annalen 96 host-volume witness, including JP2 ZIP, PDF, scandata, page-number metadata, and IA metadata.
Part 03: Internet Archive Mathematische Annalen 83, 85, and 90 host-volume witnesses, including JP2/PDF/metadata where staged.
Part 04: recent targeted witnesses for current Noether queue work, including P04 GDZ600 raw pages/crops and other recent source-only witness material.
Part 05: targeted P29/P30 source witnesses, including P29 GDZ400 raw pages/PDF/provenance and P30 paper-level IA/GDZ cutouts/concordance.
quality_label: source-witness library / source-intake support; not cumulative reader, not TeX promotion, not certification
public_caveat: This source library is intended as stable source material for audit and web-session continuation. It contains witnesses, metadata, source ledgers, crops, and source PDFs/JP2 archives; it does not by itself certify the Noether edition, synchronize translations, or promote any new TeX patch.
next_action: If uploaded, upload the manifest ZIP plus all five source-library parts as project source files or as a clearly labelled source-support supplement. Keep active working TeX/audit changes in separate compact rollups.
